releaseNotes: [AI Engine Reconstruction] The built-in basic AI engine is ready for use out of the box, with optional Firecore/cloud advanced AI engine to enhance analysis on demand.
[Low-configuration computer friendly] Reconstruct high-speed AI architecture based on CPU inference, running smoothly on low-memory devices without independent graphics cards
[Independent Firecore AI Engine] Can be run independently of the main program to provide AI capabilities to third-party applications
[Multimedia Semantic Search] Pictures, audios, and videos support natural language retrieval, and search content by semantics, pictures, and voices
[Speech to text ASR] Quickly transcribe audio and video conversations into text for easy retrieval and archiving
[Speech Synthesis TTS] Text-to-speech, built-in 50+ sounds, supports 3-second sound cloning, and reads document novels aloud
[File tag upgrade] Enrich fact tag types, the tags are more accurate and interpretable, and the tag tree supports 10 levels of expansion
[Creator Material Optimization] For designers and self-media, special optimization of audio, video and picture material sorting
[Enhanced Sensitive Content Detection] Segmentally identify pornographic, violent, terrorist, political, abusive, bloody and other illegal content and its subcategories

[Five major batch sorting modes] Identity blueprint / intelligent clustering / external AI generated directory / file derivation directory tree / custom directory tree, processing thousands of files in seconds
[Identity Blueprint (Recommended)] Select industry roles, four-stage optimization, and classify all files in milliseconds on the client side
[Intelligent Clustering] End-side HAC unsupervised clustering, generate directory trees in milliseconds, classify all files in seconds, and support real-time fine-tuning
[External AI generated directory] Copy prompt words to Doubao, Kimi, ChatGPT with one click, and preview and organize the results in real time
[Deriving directory trees from files] The advanced AI engine outputs 3 sets of directory candidates at a time, and automatic classification is selected
[Customized directory tree] Paste Markdown directory, double-column real-time preview, and build exclusive organizing rules
[In-depth UI optimization] Reconstruct the setting page structure, add a new guide and help entrance, and make the operation more intuitive.
